lodgement_guidance.text: From 1 July 2021, development applications and certificates must be lodged through the NSW Planning Portal.

citation.document_title: NSW Planning Portal - Gunnedah Shire Council
citation.quote: From 1 July 2021, development applications and certificates must be lodged through the

lodgement_guidance.text: Council can no longer accept hardcopy or emailed documents and cannot place applications on the portal on behalf of applicants.

citation.document_title: NSW Planning Portal - Gunnedah Shire Council
citation.quote: These changes mean Council can no longer accept hardcopy or emailed documents

lodgement_guidance.text: Before using the portal, get advice from the council's planning team; a free Duty Planner service is offered (02 6740 2100).

citation.document_title: NSW Planning Portal - Gunnedah Shire Council
citation.quote: Council provides a free Duty Planner Service to assist with enquiries

lodgement_guidance.text: Log in with an existing Service NSW account or register for a NSW Planning Portal account.

citation.document_title: NSW Planning Portal - Gunnedah Shire Council
citation.quote: Use your existing Service NSW account or register for a NSW Planning Portal account.

lodgement_guidance.text: Click 'New' to start the application, fill in the online form, and upload the required documents; the application can be saved and resumed.

citation.document_title: NSW Planning Portal - Gunnedah Shire Council
citation.quote: Upload required documents to the portal. You can save your application and come back to it later.

lodgement_guidance.text: A council officer reviews the application in the portal for completeness and emails if more information is needed.

citation.document_title: NSW Planning Portal - Gunnedah Shire Council
citation.quote: A Council officer will review your application in the portal to make sure all documentation is correct.

lodgement_guidance.text: Once accepted for lodgement an 'Additional Information Request' with the tax invoice is issued; fees must be paid and confirmed by responding in the portal before the DA is formally lodged.

citation.document_title: NSW Planning Portal - Gunnedah Shire Council
citation.quote: Fees must be paid before your DA is formally lodged in Council’s system.

lodgement_guidance.text: A development consent application must include a description of the development, the estimated cost, a plan of the land, a sketch of the development and an environmental assessment (e.g. a statement of environmental effects).

citation.document_title: Local Development (NSW Planning Portal)
citation.quote: environmental assessment, for example, environmental impact statement or statement of environment effects.

lodgement_guidance.text: The fee is calculated on the value of the work proposed and/or the type of development.

citation.document_title: Lodging an Application - Gunnedah Shire Council
citation.quote: The fee payable for the development application is calculated on the value of the work proposed

lodgement_guidance.text: CONFLICT TO CONFIRM WITH COUNCIL: the council's Lodging an Application page asks for a minimum of three paper copies, which conflicts with its own NSW Planning Portal page (no hardcopy accepted).

citation.document_title: Lodging an Application - Gunnedah Shire Council
citation.quote: A minimum of three (3) paper copies of all the required documentation must be prepared

lodgement_guidance.text: For complying development, the applicant provides the council with an electronic copy of all documentation and at least 1 copy of the development plans.

citation.document_title: Gunnedah Shire Council Complying Development Certificate Lodgement Checklist
citation.quote: Applicant is to provide Council with an electronic copy of all documentation

unresolved.prompt: Supply special_area (data from SA9/s10.7/council or user).

unresolved.label: Land is not in an environmentally sensitive area
unresolved.prompt: Supply environmentally_sensitive_area (data from SA9/s10.7/council or user).

unresolved.label: Land does not contain an item listed on the State Heritage Register or subject to an interim heritage order
unresolved.prompt: Supply state_heritage_item (data from SA9/s10.7/council or user).

unresolved.label: Land is not critical habitat or a wilderness area
unresolved.prompt: Supply critical_habitat_or_wilderness (data from SA9/s10.7/council or user).

unresolved.label: Flood control lot requirements
unresolved.prompt: Confirm with the council (s10.7 planning certificate) whether the lot is a flood control lot; the definition (Codes SEPP cl 1.5) and the flood control lot standards (Housing Code cl 3.5 / Inland Code cl 3D.7) were not obtained (legislation.nsw.gov.au is Cloudflare-blocked).

unresolved.label: Easements / restrictions affecting the building footprint
unresolved.prompt: No cited complying-development exclusion for easements was obtainable. Supply the title/DP easement information and confirm with the certifier and utility owners (see also build-over-sewer requirements).

unresolved.label: Development is permissible with consent in the zone under the LEP
unresolved.prompt: Gunnedah LEP 2012 land use table not obtained (Cloudflare). Supply the LEP land use table result for this zone and development.

unresolved.label: Zone R1-R5 (secondary dwellings permitted); other zones only if the LEP permits
unresolved.prompt: Outside the listed zones the development may still be permitted by the LEP: supply the LEP land use table result.

unresolved.label: The lot is not subdivided
unresolved.prompt: Supply involves_subdivision (data from SA9/s10.7/council or user).

unresolved.label: Established in conjunction with a principal dwelling on the same lot
unresolved.prompt: Supply principal_dwelling_present (data from SA9/s10.7/council or user).

unresolved.label: Not an individual lot in a strata plan or community title scheme
unresolved.prompt: Supply lot_is_strata_or_community (data from SA9/s10.7/council or user).

unresolved.label: Not land at risk of exposure to flames (flame zone, BAL-FZ)
unresolved.prompt: Obtain the s10.7 certificate and a BAL assessment (AS 3959): flame zone (BAL-FZ) excludes complying development for a secondary dwelling.

unresolved.label: Housing SEPP Schedule 1 site and design standards (floor area, setbacks, height, landscaping, parking)
unresolved.prompt: Housing SEPP 2021 Schedule 1 not obtained (Cloudflare). The NSW page says the floor area calculation includes the principal dwelling, the secondary dwelling and attached carports/garages/decks etc., but gives no limit. Resolve from Schedule 1 before relying on CDC.

unresolved.label: Bushfire-prone land requirements (BAL assessment, AS 3959, Planning for Bush Fire Protection)
unresolved.prompt: Bushfire-prone land: complying development is allowed only subject to the code's bushfire clauses (Housing Code cl 3.4 / Inland Code cl 3D.6), which were not obtained; BAL-FZ (flame zone) land is excluded for secondary dwellings (cited). Obtain a BAL assessment (AS 3959) from an accredited practitioner and the s10.7 certificate.

pathway_check.disclaimer: Decision-support only. This is not a planning, complying development or building approval, and it is not a certificate. Results depend on the data supplied and on the cited summaries (several dated 2018); the Codes SEPP, Housing SEPP and the LEP could not be obtained. Verify with the council or an accredited certifier.

disclaimer: This application pack was assembled as a drafting and lodgement aid. Nothing in it is a planning, complying development or building approval. Documents must be reviewed and adopted by suitably qualified persons, and the council or a certifier determines the application.
